principles: Editorial illustration, not photorealistic scene recreation.
Reading Mood first; plot illustration second.
Concrete enough to enter the book's world, but not so literal that it dictates one interpretation.
No ending, final fate, hidden identity, or decisive later reversal.
Stable 16:9 assets, local WebP, no external image dependency.

the-garden-party.note: Garden-party atmosphere and Laura-like observer; supports surface elegance + underlying unease without depicting the later off-site encounter.

the-hour-of-the-star.note: Rio urban overlook with a socially marginal young woman; avoids illustrating the novel's ending or a specific late plot event.

the-summer-book.note: Finnish-island summer, child-and-older-companion relationship, rocky shore and cottage; non-plot-specific.

the-age-of-innocence.note: Gilded-Age New York high-society spectacle and observation; evokes etiquette and constraint without fixing a specific canonical scene.

excellent-women.note: Postwar London, parish/neighborhood/domestic social life; intentionally atmospheric rather than a literal single scene.

passing.note: 1920s urban social interior with doubled/reflected female figures; expresses unstable identity and observation without revealing outcome.

runaway.note: Rural departure/threshold image; captures Munro's ordinary-life turning points without claiming a specific story event.

family-lexicon.note: Italian family interior, papers, conversation, wartime public presence outside; supports private language/history interplay without literalizing one memoir episode.

pedro-paramo.note: Desolate Mexican town approached by a traveler; Comala-like atmosphere, no explicit revelation about the town's inhabitants.

the-palm-wine-drinkard.note: Yoruba-inflected fantastical journey world; intentionally nonliteral composite, avoiding one-to-one depiction of a named creature or episode.

the-memory-police.note: Quiet island/coastal domestic space with distant authority figures and traces of memory; avoids specifying exactly what disappears when.

gorilla-my-love.note: Black neighborhood/community scene centered on a child's observational position; composite rather than a literal story event.

annie-john.note: Antiguan domestic/coastal setting with daughter and mother held at emotional distance; no later-development spoiler.

convenience-store-woman.note: Japanese convenience-store exterior and socially solitary female figure; conveys rule-bound normality vs private fit without plot claims.
